summary: Constitution Bench on Article 142 jurisdiction regarding mutual consent divorce under Section 13-B of Hindu Marriage Act; whether Supreme Court can waive mandatory six-month waiting period; standard for dissolution of marriages based on irretrievable breakdown; quashing collateral proceedings under Domestic Violence Act, Cr.P.C. 125, and IPC 498-A; power to dissolve marriage over unilateral opposition in irretrievable breakdown scenarios; equitable interpretation of 'complete justice' standard.
